mentions.name: Support Toolbox
mentions.description: A support workflow app with newly added text expansion, covering nearly everything the author needs for support work at their day job; further smaller improvements are planned and the updated release is pending. The text expansion replaces a separate app the author previously used.
mentions.problem: Text expansion was missing from the author's support workflow and previously required using another app.
mentions.source_excerpt: I also made some improvements to my support workflow app, Support Toolbox [2], but haven't released those yet (hopefully this week). It now also includes text expansion, which I was really missing from my workflow and had been using another app for previously.
